nodes.plm_caption: This video is an instructional film on the descaling of a coffee maker with an audio voiceover.

summary.brief: A person in a white shirt and black apron descales a Nespresso U coffee machine and then brews a cup of coffee.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a person wearing a white shirt and black apron standing behind a beige‑topped, black‑base Nespresso U machine on a gray countertop. They empty the capsule holder, place an empty 1 L container beneath the coffee outlet, and fill the water tank with about 500 ml of water mixed with the Nespresso descaling solution. The user activates descaling mode by pressing and holding the three control buttons for three seconds; the lights flash, then stop and the machine beeps. After opening the sliding window, they press the three buttons again for three seconds, confirming that descaling mode is engaged, and the solution is pumped through the machine into the container. When the flow stops, the tank is refilled with fresh water and a rinse cycle is started by pressing a button; the machine automatically empties and rinses the drip tray. After rinsing, they exit descaling mode by again holding the three buttons for three seconds, confirmed by a beep. The machine is now ready, so they take a coffee pod from the clear pod holder, insert it into the front opening, and press the brew button. Hot coffee streams into a glass mug on the small black tray, steaming. The segment finishes with an ending title screen followed by a brief Nespresso logo display.

action.detailed: Press and hold the three control buttons for three seconds to start descaling mode, fill the water tank with the descaling solution, run the solution through the machine into a container, refill the tank with fresh water, start the rinse cycle, press and hold the three buttons again for three seconds to exit descaling mode, then insert a coffee pod and brew a cup of coffee.
action.actor: A person wearing a white shirt and black apron

A person wearing a white shirt and black apron stands at a table behind a coffee maker. The coffee maker is beige on top and black on the bottom with black buttons on the right side. A set of step by step instructions appear on the screen. 

The person is seen pouring descaling solution into a mug through the front of the coffee maker. They press a button on the coffee maker. Next, the person pulls a bowl off the side of the coffee maker and fill it with the descaling solution and pour it back into the machine. The machine makes a clunking sound, and the person puts the mug back under the spout of the coffee maker. 

Next, they press buttons to run descaling mode. Then, they pour more descaling solution into the mug, and then the descaling solution is removed from the coffee maker. They press buttons again and make the coffee machine start, which runs for 20 seconds.  The coffee is now steaming and sitting on the small black tray of the coffee maker. 

A hand reaches out and picks a coffee pod off the clear plastic container and puts it inside the front opening of the coffee maker. Then, a stream of coffee starts pouring into the glass mug.

The video ends with an ending title screen.

summary.brief: A technician descales a Nespresso U machine and then brews a cup of coffee.
summary.detailed: A person wearing a white shirt and a black apron stands behind a beige‑and‑black Nespresso U coffee machine on a gray tabletop. They empty the capsule container and place an empty 1 L vessel under the coffee outlet. They fill the water tank with about 500 ml of water mixed with the descaling solution, then activate descaling mode by pressing three buttons simultaneously for three seconds. The machine beeps, the sliding window opens, and the solution flows through the machine into the vessel with a clunking sound. After emptying the vessel, they repeat the cycle with fresh water to rinse the system, then exit descaling mode with another three‑second press of the three buttons. Finally they take a coffee pod from the clear plastic container, insert it into the front opening, start the brew cycle and let steaming coffee pour into a glass mug on the machine’s black tray. The segment ends with an on‑screen title screen.

action.detailed: Activate descaling mode by pressing three buttons for three seconds, run the prepared descaling solution through the machine into a container, repeat a rinse cycle with fresh water, exit the mode, insert a coffee pod and brew coffee into a mug.
action.actor: A person wearing a white shirt and black apron

At the end there is a title screen.

It includes instructions and stills of the machine, then a title pop up appears on the screen mentioning the steps to descale the machine. It cuts to a man standing by the machine with his hands clasped in his front. Then it cuts to the man lifting the filters and pouring the filter water into a large container. He uses his fingers to remove one filter at a time, dropping them into the container. He then moves on to the water tank. He lifts the lid off of the top of the machine, then the man uses both hands to grab the machine. The man then moves the machine from his left hand to the right and picks up a jug of water and a bowl. Then the video cuts to the jug being placed on top of the machine, and the man pouring the water into the machine. Then the man uses his right hand to pour water from the jug into the bowl. Then he picks up a packet and pours that into the water in the machine, and then the video cuts to the final shot of the machine.
The video takes place during the day indoors. The man appears to be in a professional outfit.
The title card appears towards the middle of the video. The filter packets are white with black print. The bowl is mostly white with a small rim around the bottom. The bowl is set in front of a gray background.

A man wearing a white shirt and a black apron approaches the machine, lifts the top lid, removes the water‑filter and empties the capsule holder and drip tray into a waste container. He picks up a jug of water and a white bowl, places the jug on the machine and pours water into the machine’s water tank as well as into the bowl. He then opens a packet of descaling powder and pours its contents into the tank. The camera ends on the machine as a final title appears.

summary.brief: A demonstrator runs the descaling and rinse cycles on a Nespresso machine and then brews a cup of coffee.
summary.detailed: The video shows a person in a white shirt and black apron standing at a gray countertop beside a beige‑and‑black Nespresso machine. First the hand presses the off button and then activates the descaling mode by holding the three front buttons together for three seconds; the sliding window opens and the buttons are pressed again, causing the unit to beep and flash, indicating that descaling mode is on. The descaling solution that was previously placed in the water tank is pumped through the coffee outlet into a container placed below. After the solution has emptied, the tank is refilled with fresh water and the rinse cycle is started by pressing the same button, letting clean water flow out in the same way. The three‑button hold is performed a third time to exit descaling mode, the machine beeps to confirm completion, and the sliding window closes. Finally a coffee pod is inserted, a cup is positioned under the spout, and the machine brews a coffee that fills the cup.

action.detailed: Press the three front buttons simultaneously for three seconds to activate descaling mode, open and close the sliding window while pressing the buttons again, let the machine dispense the descaling solution into a container, refill the water tank with fresh water and press the button to start the rinse cycle, then hold the three buttons for three seconds again to exit descaling mode and finally brew a cup of coffee.
